repairs.reason: Yahoo reproduces a missing OHLC row with zero volume on a scheduled monthly rebalance. Share Compare publishes OHLCV for the day; ChartExchange agrees on close and volume. Neighbouring source opens/closes agree with the existing GBP series. Repair only this missing day; do not replace the history.
repairs.adjustment_basis: Existing vendor adjustment factor is 1.0 on the immediately preceding and following sessions. Yahoo records zero dividends and splits across this local interval; the repair preserves that basis.
repairs.volume_caveat: Secondary-source volume and high/low definitions differ slightly from Yahoo on adjacent days. Use the archived Share Compare record only for the missing session; do not assert independent exchange verification.
